finding: No pinned NIST source carries IR 8477 relationship types. The CPRT export's relationship types are projection, incorporated_into, moved_to, external_reference; the workbook lists references as bare identifiers. Every NIST reference is therefore an association, not a five-class label, under the frozen policy.
